notes.title: RetroMaze Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
[u][b]The game is now running in the most recent GMS2 engine version 2.3[/b][/u]

- Performance improvements in general, specially on older systems.
- Significantly reduced storage needed (From 44.5mb to 13.4mb).
- QoL improvements, including "disco ball" (character) movement.
